meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 给已安装 Dial 频道的 NanoClaw 再加一个电话号码，让同一套安装用多个号码接收短信和 AI 语音来电。每个号码是独立的线程化线路，回复从收到消息的那个号码发出，已有线路不受影响。
howto.when: 当 Dial 频道已经装好、你想给 agent 增加第二个或第三个号码（例如个人线加客服线）时触发。前置条件：Dial 必须先安装，否则先运行 /add-dial。

say.text: 给 Dial 加一个新号码 +14155550123
say.note: 先确认 Dial 已装，再校验该号码属于当前账号。

say.text: 列出这个 Dial 账号现有的号码
say.note: 列出账号下已有的 Dial 号码。

say.text: 新号码用 strict，只让已知用户发消息
say.note: 决定谁能向这条新线路发起对话。

howto.what_en: Add another number to an existing Dial channel so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on several numbers. Each number is a separate threaded line; replies leave from the number that got the message, and existing lines are unchanged.
howto.when_en: Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an extra number, e.g. a personal line plus a support line. Dial must be installed first (see /add-dial).

say_en.note: Checks Dial is installed, then verifies the number belongs to the account.

say_en.text: List the Dial numbers on this account
say_en.note: Shows the account's current Dial numbers.

say_en.text: Make this new line strict, known users only
say_en.note: Sets who may start conversations on the new line.
